cyanheads-fs: sh -c 'npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --prefix /tmp/sealmark-cyanheads-fs @cyanheads/filesystem-mcp-server@1.0.4 1>&2 && exec env FS_BASE_DIRECTORY="$0" node /tmp/sealmark-cyanheads-fs/node_modules/@cyanheads/filesystem-mcp-server/dist/index.js' {sandbox}
postgres-mcp: sh -c 'o=$(mktemp) && echo pglast==7.20 > "$o" && exec uvx --overrides "$o" --with "mcp<2" postgres-mcp@0.3.0 "$0"' {dsn}
